# ProofOnce

> A new product from Instilligent Limited. Currently pre-launch — site is in
> "Coming Soon" mode collecting interest. The intended product category is
> document and identity verification: prove something once, reuse the proof
> across multiple consumers without re-presenting source documents.

## Status

Pre-launch. The site at https://proofonce.com is a coming-soon landing page
with no public product features yet. Specifications and detailed positioning
will be published when the first version ships.

## Built by

Instilligent Limited — https://instilligent.com — NZ AI consultancy and
product studio. We build production AI software for regulated industries
across NZ, Australia, and Southeast Asia. Marc Armstrong, founder.
